bio.text: Marty O'Donnell is the Republican candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election for Nevada's 3rd Congressional District, where he is running against incumbent Susie Lee (D).
He is a former composer and sound designer in the film and video game industries.
He has never held elected office, and he previously ran in the 2024 Republican primary for the same district.
According to Nevada Current, he moved to Southern Nevada about three years before his 2024 run.

sources.title: Three candidates are running in Nevada's 3rd District, where the last two elections were decided by fewer than four points
